# The reference scenarios of fixtures/scenarios/lay/ as the desktop tidies them
# (LAY-06): each card and chip at the size the board draws it, each wire as the
# ports the router is given. A card hung under a
# step names the card above it in its stack (`under`, LAY-31); a line of the chain of
# steps ends in `chain` (LAY-45). The quality example
# routes and measures these. Written by the desktop's acceptance test
# lay06_criterion_10_quality_on_real_card_sizes with APIFORGE_WRITE_BOARDS=1;
# do not edit by hand.
